sec_evidence.acceptance_datetime_source: SEC EDGAR SGML header ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME (Eastern wall clock), independently fetched and hashed for every 10-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q, 8-K and 8-K/A accession; the remaining rows carry the SEC submissions API acceptance time converted to Eastern and are labelled SEC_SUBMISSIONS_API_DERIVED with header_verified=false

sources_attempted: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SOFI (Yahoo Finance chart API v8, external acquisition, 1255 daily closes)
https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1818874/<accession>/<accession>-index-headers.html (SEC SGML headers, 109 filings independently fetched and hashed)
data/archives/SOFI.sqlite (SQLite archive, secondary source, 2 pre-existing price observations, not repackaged as new data)
known_gaps: FY2021 Q4 has no Form 8-K Item 2.02 earnings release in EDGAR, so no furnished Q4 EPS evidence exists for that quarter; it is not fabricated and the resulting windows are refused with REASON_MISSING_Q4_EPS.

The 864 acceptance rows for forms other than 10-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q, 8-K and 8-K/A carry the SEC submissions API acceptance time converted to Eastern; they are labelled SEC_SUBMISSIONS_API_DERIVED with header_verified=false and carry no header hash. None of them is used by the historical P/E pipeline.
SOFI is not registered in historical_pe.ISSUER_CONFIGS, so the web path does not serve this distribution; the qualification recorded here comes from running the production loader directly.
note: Qualified historical P/E dataset. 1255 daily closes acquired from Yahoo Finance (USD, as-traded) and 69 SEC diluted-EPS XBRL facts plus 4 furnished Q4 earnings records give the production pipeline a real evidence set; it returns USABLE_FOR_REFERENCE with 130 qualifying observations over 2024-11-08..2026-09-24 (median 47.299768) and an AVAILABLE current snapshot at 30.21875. The >=20-observation reference gate is unchanged and was met by the evidence, not by relaxing any rule. prices_manifest.json continues to describe the price acquisition on its own. The dataset files are stored with canonical LF bytes and forward-slash paths so the recorded digests and paths are identical on Windows and on Linux.
